name: 30° Manual Dive
summary: Fixed sight, 30° dive, 450 kt, release by 4,500 ft

sight.notes: Mk-82 LD, 30° / 450 KIAS / 4,500 ft — check the F-5E manual depression tables for the actual load

procedure: Sight mode MSL (manual), depression set, station selected
Roll in, establish 30° and 450 kt — hold them
Pipper on the target at release altitude: pickle, 4 G recovery
source: community practice (Chuck's Guide F-5E depression tables, estimated)

name: 45° Manual Dive
summary: Fixed sight, steep dive from 12,000 ft, release by 6,500 ft

sight.notes: Mk-82 LD, 45° / 450 KIAS / 6,500 ft — check the depression tables

procedure: Steep roll-in; throttle back to hold 450 kt
Pipper on at release altitude: pickle, 5 G recovery — do not press
source: community practice (Chuck's Guide F-5E depression tables, estimated)

name: Laydown 500 ft (HD)
summary: Fast and low with Snakeyes or CBUs
procedure: Level at 500 ft, 480 kt — pickle as the target passes the reticle

name: Gun 10°
summary: Shallow gun pass, cease by 1,000 ft
procedure: Guns selected, sight mode for guns
Roll in, pipper on, short bursts
Cease fire at 1,000 ft and pull — never press a gun pass
